title: How to get a tech job without a CS degree using AI

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You don't need a CS degree—AI tools like GitHub Copilot and LangChain automate coding, making technical skills accessible to anyone.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But how will employers trust your code? They look for structured problem-solving, not just AI-generated lines. You need to *know* the "to" of programming.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Millions use AI to build real apps—like TensorFlow and PyTorch. You don't need a degree to master Python or debug a neural network.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That’s just luck. Real tech jobs require understanding algorithms, data structures, and system design—AI can’t teach you that.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Without knowing *how* systems work, AI is just a crutch. Employers want people who can *build*, not just copy.
